title: The Value of Competitor Information: Evidence from a Field Experiment
near_miss_reason: The treatment visit_treat (randomly assigned treatment firm x months since the Yelp canvasser visit) switches on at firm-specific visit weeks with never-treated control firms, but every reported column is a pooled OLS of the form reg y visit treat visit_treat i.yelp_canvass_week, vce(cluster salon_id): no firm fixed effects, calendar-month fixed effects only in Table 2A columns 2 and 4, and an additional staggered regressor 'visit' (the post-visit indicator, which also switches on for control firms because canvassers visit both arms). The 'visit' main effect is an extra treatment-like regressor under the protocol, and the specification lacks unit FE.
eligible_reason: Staggered binary design exists (visit weeks vary across 3,218 salons; treat is randomized; controls are never treated with information), but no reported column has unit FE and calendar-time FE with only the treatment indicator. Data are proprietary (Yelp agreement) and not shipped.
design_notes: Salon x survey-month panel (master_ra_yelp.dta; 30,142 salon-months in Table 2A). visit = 1 from the month the firm is visited by Yelp canvassers (yelp_canvass_week is the visit week, used as cohort FE); treat = random assignment to receive competitor price information; visit_treat = visit x treat (labelled 'Post * Treat' in t2a_ate.tex). Table 2A (analysis.do lines 172-175): reg svy_bs_diff visit treat visit_treat i.yelp_canvass_week [i.svy_survey_month] [i.strata], vce(cluster salon_id); coefficients on visit_treat 0.029-0.030 (SE 0.013). Table 2B: svy_bs_smaller, svy_bs_greater, logprice. Table 3A: ln_mo_calls, ln_mo_pageviews, ln_mo_dir_map_views, svy_avail_4_to_5; Table 3B: platform engagement outcomes. Figure 5B: elapse3mo bins (0, 3, 6 months since visit) interacted with treat. Table 4: follow-up experiment (cross-section). Randomization stratified (randomization.do).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Cohorts are Yelp canvasser visit weeks (yelp_canvass_week); number of distinct weeks not recoverable without the data (several, since it enters as a factor variable).

data_files_note: readme.pdf: 'The data are not included in the replication folder due to data confidentiality and the data agreement with Yelp.' Only code (master.do, randomization.do, analysis.do), the replication log and output tables/figures are shipped.
priority_note: Near-miss on specification (no unit FE; visit main effect) and data not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Published coefficients for Table 2A taken from results/t2a_ate.tex. The paper is a randomized field experiment; the staggered element is the canvasser visit schedule shared by both arms, so a controls-free TWFE on visit_treat alone would drop the control group's own post-visit response, which the authors absorb with the visit main effect.
